text:
5 minutes - Logging in to CLUE & Lesson Intro

  • Logging into CLUE (3 minutes)
  • Telling students that they will be learning about CLUE (2 minutes)

10 minutes - Investigate: Subtraction Machine

  • Individual: have students try to figure out how to connect a program to make it subtract two numbers
  • Quick class discussion: How did students figure this out?

20 minutes - Design: Connecting a Demo Gripper & Gripper Experiment

  • Pairs: Students figure out how to connect a demo gripper, and work in pairs to figure out how the gripper works (they should be recording their trials in a table - they can use the "group doc" function for this if they want) (10 minutes)
  • Class discussion: Students share how they connected their demo gripper and the findings of their experiments. Try to keep a running list of how the demo gripper was connected, and ask students to share what strategies they used (if any) to figure things out. (10 minutes)

15 minutes - Develop: Developing an Automatic Machine

  • Individual OR pairs (up to you): Figuring out how to make the gripper open and close automatically. (8 minutes)
  • Class discussion: What did you try? What worked/didn't work? (7 minutes)

5 minutes - Evaluate (Exit ticket)

  • Individual: documenting their understanding of the gripper and think about a strategy for figuring out new ideas. (5 minutes)
  • Optional: You can solicit some ideas before or after they write them down
